performance.verdict: All 10 SOW milestones overdue; no Google, LSA, or organic channel live yet.

findings.text: 5 July-31 milestones overdue: pre-launch stack test, Como→GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account/CAPI, and landing pages — none confirmed complete as of Oct 3.
5 Aug–Sep milestones overdue: Meta reactivation lanes, Search campaigns, LSA verification, nurture sequences, and Phase 1 close/Phase 2 conversation — all undelivered.

CPL spiked 92.5% week-over-week. 3-day signal (Sep 30–Oct 2: 9+2+4=15 leads, $149.50 spend, ~$10 CPL) vs prior 3 days (Sep 27–29: 0+0+4=4 leads, $86.66 spend) confirms deterioration is sustained, not a single-day blip.
Sep 20–22 spend dropped to $0 for 3 consecutive days, killing lead flow entirely; spend resumed Sep 23 but GA4 sessions remain 46–62 vs prior peak of 165, suggesting audience or budget reset damage.
GBP actions rose 18% (65 total, 28-day) while paid leads fell 55%; organic floor is holding but Google Ads spend is $0 across all 45 days — no search channel has ever been active.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 10 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer; no paid scaling until landing pages and tracking are confirmed live.
suggestions.monday_update: All 10 SOW milestones from July–September are unconfirmed complete as of Oct 3. Nacer to provide a written status on each item — especially landing pages, tracking, and the pre-launch stack test — before any budget change is approved. Success check: written confirmation from Nacer on all 10 items by Oct 6. No paid scaling or new channel launch until landing pages and pixel tracking are verified live.

suggestions.text: Monitor Meta CPL daily for 3 days; if CPL stays above $10 after spend stabilises, escalate to creative_refresh.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta CPL spiked 92.5% week-over-week and the 3-day signal (Sep 30–Oct 2) shows ~$10 CPL vs the 28-day average of $5.87. The 3-day zero-spend gap (Sep 20–22) likely disrupted audience learning. Watch the next 3 full days — if CPL does not return below $7.00 by Oct 6, escalate to a creative refresh on the MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP campaign. No budget change this cycle.

suggestions.text: Note Google Ads $0 spend across 45 days; re-check once Search campaigns milestone is confirmed delivered.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has recorded $0 spend across all 45 days in the series — Search campaigns are listed as an Aug 31 SOW milestone and remain undelivered. GBP is generating 65 actions over 28 days without any paid search support. No action is possible until the Search campaigns milestone (F2) is cleared by Nacer. Re-check on Oct 6 alongside the broader milestone escalation.
